appDescription.message: Find and save web videos you are authorised to access.

listenDescription.message: You will be asked before anything is downloaded.

readyWithoutService.message: No other program needs to be started

listeningHelp.message: Start playback and detected videos will appear here.

listeningOffHelp.message: Turn it on, then play the video you want to save.

noVideosListening.message: Listening. Play a video to see save options here.

noVideosOff.message: Turn on detection to find videos.

chooseSaveMethod.message: Direct download is recommended. Use web-assisted saving when playback must remain active.

assistedTaskCreated.message: Web-assisted saving created. Keep the download page open and continue playback.

ignoredThisTime.message: Ignored this time. Nothing will be downloaded.

downloadCenterDescription.message: View progress, continue downloads, and find saved files.

noDownloadTasks.message: No downloads yet. Detect and play a video, then create one from the extension popup.

chooseFolderIntro.message: Choose or create a dedicated subfolder, such as Downloads/Web Keeper. For safety, browsers do not grant direct access to the Downloads, Desktop, or Documents root folder.

diagnosticsDescription.message: Open this only when something goes wrong.

settingsDescription.message: These options affect future actions and never move or delete existing files.

showDiagnostics.message: Show the diagnostics entry on download pages

reloadForLanguage.message: Language updated. Reopen other extension pages to apply it.

directReadyMessage.message: Ready to download. The finished file uses browser Downloads by default.

assistedReadyMessage.message: The task is ready. Return to the original page and continue playback.

folderPermissionNeeded.message: The save location needs permission again. Select Continue.

taskPausedMessage.message: Download paused. Saved content has been kept.

temporaryFilesDeleted.message: Temporary files for this download were cleaned. The generated video remains.

deleteTemporaryConfirm.message: Clean temporary files for this download? Generated videos and previously saved content will remain.

browserUnsupportedFolder.message: This browser cannot write directly to a selected folder. Use the latest Chrome or Edge.

taskNotFound.message: This video is no longer available here. Return to the page, play it briefly, then reopen the extension.

playlistNotFound.message: Complete video information has not been detected yet. Return to the page, play briefly, then retry.

playlistEmpty.message: No downloadable video content was found.

unsupportedEncryption.message: This video encryption method is not supported yet: $METHOD$

keyLengthInvalid.message: Video decryption information is invalid ($COUNT$ bytes).

folderNeedsPermission.message: The save location needs permission again.

folderPermissionDenied.message: Write access to the save location was not granted.

downloadedItemTooSmall.message: Downloaded item $INDEX$ is only $SIZE$ bytes and below the valid segment size, so it was ignored.

tinySegmentDiscarded.message: Segment $INDEX$ is only $SIZE$ bytes, so it was treated as invalid and left for retry.

tinySegmentNeedsRetry.message: Segment $INDEX$ is only $SIZE$ bytes and the timing breaks around it ($WHAT$); retrying.

segmentMarkedSkippable.message: Segment $INDEX$ can be skipped: neighboring timestamps already line up (gap about $DELTA$s, playlist about $EXPECTED$s), so it will not be retried.

skippableSegmentsNote.message: $COUNT$ empty/skippable segment(s) confirmed (neighbors are continuous; no retry).

creatingPlayableVideoSkippable.message: Creating a playable video; $COUNT$ confirmed empty segment(s) will be skipped.

outputCompleteSkippable.message: Created $NAME$. Skipped $COUNT$ empty segment(s) because neighboring timestamps were continuous.

skippableVerdictsCleared.message: Cleared previous skippable verdicts ($REASON$) and will reassess using the current segment timeline.

timelineRecheckAfterPause.message: Paused for about $MINUTES$ minute(s). Previous skippable verdicts were cleared, and new segments will be checked for timeline alignment. If they no longer match, a break is marked and downloading continues.

timelineShiftDetected.message: Segment $INDEX$ does not line up with neighboring saved segments (gap about $DELTA$s, $REASON$). The source/session may have changed after a long pause. Previous skippable verdicts were cleared; gaps will be rechecked. Keep the same quality before continuing.

timelineShiftAdjusted.message: Source timing breaks at segment $INDEX$ ($WHAT$). Marked; download continues.

timelineBreaksNote.message: $COUNT$ discontinuities in the source; downloading and building are unaffected.

creatingWithTimelineBreaks.message: $COUNT$ marked timeline break(s) are present; timestamps will be remapped where possible while creating the video.

stallAtMissingHint.message: The player is near the gap $START$ – $END$.

stallFarFromMissingHint.message: The player is near $TIME$, about $SKEW$s away from the nearest gap $START$ – $END$.

stallSmartFillAlert.message: Progress has not increased for about $SECONDS$ seconds. $PLAYER$$HINT$Confirm the page is still loading, or play the gap manually before continuing assisted fill.

stallDirectAlert.message: Progress has not increased for about $SECONDS$ seconds. Continue later, or switch to web-assisted saving.

stallCaptureAlert.message: Progress has not increased for about $SECONDS$ seconds. $PLAYER$$HINT$Return to the page to play, enable auto-seek, or use assisted gap filling.

smartFillNothingMissing.message: No missing segments are detected right now.

smartFillSeekSkew.message: The player is at $ACTUAL$, far from the target gap $START$ – $END$. Retrying the seek; if this keeps failing, drag there manually.

smartFillRangeStillMissing.message: This gap is still incomplete (about $START$ – $END$, $COUNT$ item(s) left). Make sure the page plays that time, then continue.

smartFillNextRange.message: This gap was handled. Next gap is about $START$ – $END$ ($COUNT$ item(s), $REMAINING$ gap(s) left). Auto-seeking continues.

directDownloadWorking.message: Getting video content and saving unfinished parts. You can leave this page in the background, but keep the browser open.

allContentSaved.message: All video content is saved. Creating a playable file now.

recoverableDownloadError.message: $ERROR$ Saved content has been kept. Return to the page, refresh it, and continue.

assistedWorking.message: Following web playback and saving content without requesting ahead.

assistedWaiting.message: $ERROR$ Return to the video page and continue playback. Web Keeper will wait for new content.

assistedSaving.message: Following playback and saving content. Completed content is kept and you can pause at any time.

assistedItemFailed.message: One part could not be saved yet: $ERROR$. It will be retried automatically.

assistedItemGaveUp.message: One part failed several times: $ERROR$. Use assisted gap filling, or replay that part of the page.

captureSpeedApplied.message: Playing muted at $RATE$x to save faster. If the player cannot keep up, use assisted gap filling for what is missed.

captureSpeedLimited.message: The site limited playback to $ACTUAL$x, so $WANTED$x is not possible.

captureSeekBoostApplied.message: Now seeking about +$STEP$ seconds every $INTERVAL$ second(s) (like Right Arrow). This does not need player speed control.

captureSpeedFallbackSeek.message: No speed-controllable player was found, so automatic seeking (+$STEP$s every $INTERVAL$s) is used instead.

captureSpeedFallbackSeekLimited.message: The site does not allow $WANTED$x (about $ACTUAL$x now), so automatic seeking (+$STEP$s every $INTERVAL$s) is used instead.

captureSeekBoostEnded.message: Seeking reached near the end. Use assisted gap filling if anything is still missing.

dismissCandidateHint.message: Clears detection records only. Created downloads, saved files and checkpoints are untouched.

dismissAllCandidates.message: Clear all detections without a download ($COUNT$)

dismissAllCandidatesConfirm.message: Clear $COUNT$ detection record(s) that have no download? Created downloads, saved files and checkpoints are untouched.

legacyChooseVariantsHint.message: Importing copies segments into extension storage, so pick only the quality you actually need.

legacyCopyIntoStorageHint.message: By default the original folder is referenced in place, using no extra space, but it must not be moved or deleted.

legacyLinkedNote.message: Segments are referenced from $LABEL$ without a copy. Do not move or delete that folder before creating the video.

legacySourceUnavailable.message: The legacy capture folder ($LABEL$) cannot be read right now. Grant access to it again and retry.

legacyNeedsBinding.message: Imported segments have no downloadable address. Open the original page for this video and start playback; Web Keeper will attach to the real playlist and then fill the gaps.

legacyBoundToPage.message: Attached to the page's real playlist. Keep playing to fill the gaps.

legacyPlaylistMismatch.message: The page playlist has $LIVE$ segments while the imported folder is numbered for $IMPORTED$. They do not line up, so continuing automatically was stopped to avoid filling the wrong positions.

connectionDetached.message: Page link: not attached yet. Open this video's page and start playback.

connectionLastSeen.message: Last media request from the page: $SECONDS$s ago ($KIND$)

connectionNothingSeen.message: No media request for this video has been seen yet.

connectionLegacySource.message: Segment source: referenced in place from $LABEL$ (not copied)

needsPageAttached.message: Attach to the page first: open this video's page and start playback.

noVideoPageKnown.message: The page address for this video is not known yet. Open the video's page and start playback; Web Keeper will attach automatically.

missingListCopied.message: Copied the full list of $COUNT$ gap(s): time, segment numbers, count and kind.

missingListCopyFailed.message: Could not write to the clipboard; the gap list was written to the diagnostics log.

connectionLastSequence.message: Last segment the player asked for: #$SEQUENCE$

videoTabUnavailable.message: The tab with the original page is closed or cannot be accessed. Open the video page again and start playback.

videoTabOtherContext.message: Requests for this video are still arriving, but this page cannot control that tab. Usually the video is in an InPrivate window while the task page is in a normal one, or the other way round. Put both in the same kind of window and retry.

coverageLegend.message: Blue is saved, grey is missing; the bar spans the whole duration.

smartFillRangeSkipped.message: Nothing new arrived near $AT$; skipping this gap and moving on ($COUNT$ skipped so far).

captureConcurrencyEight.message: Fastest (8, the site may throttle you)

directFillNeedsUrls.message: Real segment addresses are not known yet. Open the original page and play it so the task attaches to the page playlist.

directFillConfirm.message: Fill $COUNT$ missing segment(s) directly? No playback needed; requests use the configured concurrency.

directFillBlocked.message: The site refused direct requests repeatedly and probably requires the player session. Direct filling stopped; use assisted gap filling instead.

pageBufferWait.message: Wait for bytes the page already received

verifyNothing.message: There are no segments to check yet.

verifyConfirm.message: Check $COUNT$ segment(s)? Every one is read in full (legacy segments are also decrypted), which can take a few minutes.

verifyFoundBad.message: Check finished: $BAD$ of $TOTAL$ segment(s) were invalid and are gaps again, ready to re-fill.

verifyAllGood.message: Check finished: all $COUNT$ segment(s) are valid. The video can be created.

mergeNeedsExternal.message: Extension storage cannot hold the output (about $NEEDED$ needed, $FREE$ free). Pick a save location and the file is written straight there.

mergeExternalCancelled.message: No save location was chosen. Free space by cleaning other tasks' temporary files and retry.

outputSavedExternal.message: The finished file was saved straight to your chosen location: $NAME$

outputFailedQuota.message: Creating the video failed: extension storage is full. Clean other tasks' temporary files in the download centre, or retry and pick a folder to save into directly. ($ERROR$)

mergeExternalRetry.message: Pick a location and create again

allSavedCreateNow.message: Everything is saved. Choose Check and create video; if storage is short you will be asked for a save location.

progressSkippableSuffix.message: (includes $COUNT$ empty shells that need no download)

largeOutputNeedsLocation.message: The output is about $SIZE$, so a save location must be chosen first; the file is written straight there and uses no extension storage.

mergeCommitting.message: All segments processed; committing the file now (a large file can take a few minutes)…

bindNoCandidates.message: No playing video has been detected recently. Make sure video detection is on, play the target video for a few seconds, then retry.

bindPickPrompt.message:
Several playing videos were detected. Enter the number of the one to attach:
$LINES$

removeTaskDataConfirm.message: Also delete the segments and temporary files this task saved? (A referenced legacy folder is untouched, and the finished video is kept.)

subtitlesPublished.message: Saved $COUNT$ imported subtitle file(s) to Downloads.

subtitlesNone.message: This task has no subtitles to save.

taskLostPrivate.message: This task record no longer exists. In a private window all extension data lives in memory only and is discarded once every such window is closed. Import and download again in a normal window.

taskRecordLost.message: The detailed record for "$NAME$" was lost and only the list entry remains. Import that work folder again; segments already on disk are not downloaded twice.

privateWindowWarning.message: Note: this is a private window. Extension data lives in memory only and both tasks and saved segments are lost once every private window is closed.

taskEntryLost.message: The detailed record is gone, so this cannot be continued. Task data in a private window lives in memory only.

privateWindowEphemeral.message: Note: this is a private window and the destination is browser Downloads, so newly downloaded segments live in memory and are lost on a crash or when the window closes. Switch the destination to a custom folder in Settings to write them straight to disk.

privateWindowFolderOk.message: Private window: the task record is lost when the window closes, but segments are written straight into your chosen folder, so after a crash you can import that folder again and continue.

switchFolderMoving.message: Carrying saved segments over to the new folder: $DONE$/$TOTAL$

switchFolderDone.message: Now saving into "$NAME$" and carried $COUNT$ saved segment(s) over. Everything downloaded from now on is written straight to disk.

switchFolderReady.message: Now saving into "$NAME$". Everything downloaded from now on is written straight to disk.

legacySyntheticNote.message: This folder has no playlist file, so gaps were inferred from the files present and real missing segments may be invisible. Attaching to the original page recalculates them from the real playlist.

subtitlePlaylistEmpty.message: The subtitle playlist has nothing readable in it.

subtitleSearching.message: Looking for subtitles for this video…

subtitleSearchDone.message: Subtitle search finished: $TOTAL$ track(s) known ($ADDED$ newly found).

subtitleNeedsSession.message: The subtitles are encrypted and need the page sign-in details to open. Play the video once on the signed-in page and retry.

subtitleDecrypted.message: The subtitles were encrypted and were opened using the page sign-in details.

subtitleConvertHint.message: Chinese conversion uses the OpenCC dictionaries, which resolve characters by phrase.

subtitleConvertPartial.message: Chinese conversion uses a built-in table of common characters; about $COUNT$ character(s) in this sample had no rule and were left as they are.

subtitleUnknownFormat.message: The subtitle content is not a known format ($SIZE$ bytes, starts with: $HEAD$).

subtitleDecryptFailed.message: The subtitle could not be decrypted ($KEYS$ keys × $IDS$ identities tried). Make sure the original page is signed in and has played the video, then try again.

subtitleDecryptNotVtt.message: The decrypted subtitle is not recognisable subtitle text; the site may have changed its format.

subtitleFromPageBuffer.message: The subtitle was taken from what the page already received.

subtitleNeedsReplay.message: This site’s subtitle endpoint only answers calls made by the page. Return to the video page, turn subtitles on and play for a few seconds, then save again.

subtitlePartialCoverage.message: Only one subtitle request was recorded, so this may cover just the part that was played. Play the page through (playback speed helps) and save again to complete it.

subtitleCoverageShort.message: The subtitle only reaches $COVERED$ of a $TOTAL$ video, which usually means a free preview was fetched. Leave this task page open, reload the video page with F5 and turn subtitles on, then save again.

subtitleSweepDirect.message: Fetching the subtitle directly: $COUNT$ extra part(s), now reaching $COVERED$.

subtitleSweptDirect.message: Fetched $COUNT$ extra subtitle part(s) directly, now reaching $COVERED$.

subtitleSweepUnavailable.message: The paging parameter of this subtitle API shows no usable pattern; only the player sweep can complete it.

subtitleSweepNeedsPage.message: Sweeping the player needs the original page attached first.

subtitleSweepPlayer.message: Sweeping the player: $COUNT$ new part(s) recorded, now at $POSITION$.

subtitleSweepPlayerDone.message: The player sweep finished and recorded $COUNT$ new subtitle call(s).

subtitleDirectStart.message: $COUNT$ subtitle call(s) recorded; fetching the rest of the track directly.

subtitleDirectNeedsCalls.message: Only $COUNT$ subtitle call(s) recorded, which is not enough to work out the paging (two are needed). Turn subtitles on in the page player and jump to another position for a few seconds, or use the player sweep.

subtitleSweepNeedsDiscover.message: Discovery is off, so subtitle requests the browser makes are not recorded. Turn on video discovery in the extension popup first.

subtitleSweepHint.message: Turn subtitles on in the page player before sweeping: with subtitles off the player never requests them, so any sweep reports zero.

subtitleSweepNoNew.message: This tab has recorded subtitle calls before but none are new, so the player may already have the whole track cached locally. Try Save subtitles directly.

subtitleSweepNoCalls.message: No subtitle request was seen at all. The usual cause is that subtitles are off in the player (nothing is requested then); the next is the wrong tab. Turn subtitles on, drag the position bar once to confirm they really display, then sweep again.

subtitleProbing.message: Probing the subtitle API for its paging parameter (up to $COUNT$ requests)…

subtitleProbeFound.message: Probe succeeded: the paging cursor is field $FIELD$ with a step of $STEP$.

subtitleProbeFailed.message: Every integer parameter was probed and the API kept returning the same chunk, so the cursor is not a plain number (likely a string token). Use the player sweep instead.

subtitleAssembled.message: The subtitle was assembled from $PARTS$ part(s): $CUES$ cues covering $FROM$ – $TO$.

subtitleFramesDecoded.message: $PARTS$ subtitle part(s) decoded from this one reply ($FRAMES$ data frames).

subtitleDiagnosticsCopied.message: The subtitle API diagnostics were copied to the clipboard (and written to Diagnostics below).

subtitleDiagnosticsLogged.message: The subtitle API diagnostics were written to Diagnostics below.

subtitleNoPaging.message: This request carries a single id and changing it returns nothing new. Since the page does show subtitles later on, seek to a later position, wait for a subtitle to appear, then run the subtitle API diagnostics again: a second call should be recorded, and the difference between the two parameters is the answer.

verifyUndecided.message: $COUNT$ more could not be judged (encrypted but not decryptable, or the source file was unreadable); they were kept as they are, not deleted.

directSegmentsSkipped.message: $COUNT$ of $TOTAL$ segments in this round could not be saved yet ($REASON$); the rest were processed and you can continue or use smart fill later.

subtitlesOnlyReady.message: Subtitles only: no video content will be downloaded.

subtitleViaPage.message: The subtitle was requested by the page itself ($BYTES$ bytes).

folderBlocked.message: The browser does not allow picking Downloads, Desktop, Documents or your home folder directly. Create a subfolder inside one of them (for example Downloads/WebKeeper) and pick that instead.

downloadedItemEmpty.message: The server returned only $SIZE$ bytes for item $INDEX$ and the surrounding timing does not join, so it cannot be judged an empty segment.

driveRootFolder.message: the drive root (the browser does not expose full paths)

segmentConfirmedEmpty.message: Segment $INDEX$ came back empty twice, so it is treated as an empty segment.

subtitleConvertFallback.message: The Chinese conversion dictionaries failed to load; the built-in table was used instead (it makes mistakes).

segmentIndexWritten.message: Segment index written ($COUNT$ fragments); players can start without scanning the whole file.

segmentIndexSkipped.message: More fragments than the reserved index space; no index was written this time.

captureQualityAdopted.message: Now saving the quality the player is actually using.

captureLiveWaiting.message: Live content keeps saving. Choose Check and create video when you want to stop.

captureQualityChanged.message: The player switched quality. This task keeps saving the original quality only. Lock the quality on the page to avoid gaps.

remainingCount.message: $COUNT$ item(s) still need to be filled.

createPartialConfirm.message: $COUNT$ item(s) are still missing. Create an incomplete video from available content?

creatingPartial.message: Creating a video from available content and skipping $COUNT$ gap(s).

outputComplete.message: Created $NAME$. After checking playback, you can clean the temporary download files.

badgeVideoFound.message: Web Keeper: video found — choose how to save it

candidateGone.message: This video is no longer available. Play it again and retry.

directFileUrlMissing.message: The file download address was not found. Return to the page, play it again, and retry.

directFileWorking.message: Saving the video file directly. If interrupted, it can continue from the bytes already written.

dashNotReady.message: This video uses separate audio and video tracks. Web Keeper detected them, but this version cannot merge them reliably yet. Choose web-assisted saving or wait for DASH support.

mediaTypeUnsupported.message: A video request was found, but this version cannot identify how to save it yet.

removeTaskConfirm.message: Remove this task from the download centre? Saved files and resumable content will be kept.

rangeNotSupported.message: The site did not return the requested media range. The download was stopped to avoid creating a damaged video.

dashManifestMissing.message: Complete DASH video information has not been found. Return to the page, play briefly, then retry.

dashWorking.message: Downloading the video and audio tracks. Completed parts can be resumed later.

dashInitMissing.message: This video did not provide usable track initialization information.

dashNoTracks.message: No directly downloadable DASH audio or video tracks were found.

dashMerging.message: The video and audio tracks are downloaded. Creating one playable file now.

drmUnsupported.message: This video is DRM-protected. Web Keeper will not attempt to bypass the site's access controls.

directStalled.message: Direct download has no new content for now. Continue later, or confirm a switch to web-assisted saving.

liveWaiting.message: Waiting for the site to publish more content. Saved parts will not be lost.

switchToAssistedConfirm.message: Switch to web-assisted saving? Keep this task page open and continue playback on the original page.

interruptedReadyToResume.message: The previous run stopped when its page closed. Saved content is still available; select Continue to resume.

noTaskForVideo.message: No download has been created for this video yet.

smartFillConfirm.message: Start assisted gap filling? Web Keeper will seek the original page to missing positions and slow down or stop when loading cannot keep up.

smartFillWorking.message: Playing the missing positions. Web Keeper will wait when the player loads slowly.

videoElementNotFound.message: No controllable video player was found on the original page. Play the indicated position manually.

smartFillNoProgress.message: No new content arrived near $TIME$, so automatic seeking stopped. Play this position manually, then continue.

smartFillStillMissing.message: $COUNT$ item(s) still need manual playback ($SKIPPED$ gap(s) were not filled this round).

smartFillComplete.message: Missing positions are filled. Checking the video now.

saveLocationUpdated.message: The save location was updated. Existing files were not moved.

saveLocationForgotten.message: The save location was forgotten. No files were deleted.

deleteOutputConfirm.message: Delete the generated video $NAME$? Temporary download content and the task record will be kept.

outputDeleted.message: $NAME$ was deleted. Other saved content is still available.

rememberForSite.message: Remember this site's recommended method and quality

hlsSeparateTracksUnsupported.message: This HLS video uses a separate audio format that cannot yet be combined reliably in the browser. Confirm web-assisted saving instead.

hlsMapIvRequired.message: The HLS initialization segment is encrypted without an explicit IV. Direct download stopped to avoid creating a damaged file; use web-assisted saving instead.

readyToCreateMessage.message: All content is downloaded and ready for video creation.

savedFileTooSmall.message: The result is only $SIZE$ and does not look like a complete video.

downloadReturnedDocument.message: The site returned a web page or error response instead of media data.

videoTrackMissing.message: Only an audio track was detected; there is no video picture. Replay the page to detect the complete video, or use web-assisted capture.

videoValidationFailed.message: The result did not pass video-track validation. The file and task were kept, but it was not marked complete and temporary data was not deleted.

transmuxerUnavailable.message: The media packaging component did not load, so a playable MP4 cannot be created.

unexpectedSegmentFormat.message: The downloaded parts are not a recognized video format. Video creation was stopped.

outputCompleteAndCleaned.message: $NAME$ was created and validated. Temporary parts were deleted automatically.

legacyOutputInvalid.message: The older output failed video validation: $ERROR$. The file and parts were kept. Replay the page and select Continue; Web Keeper will prefer the complete direct media response.

exportingToDownloads.message: Moving the validated video to the browser Downloads folder.

browserDownloadFailed.message: The browser could not save the finished file: $ERROR$

browserStorageUnavailable.message: The browser could not provide private extension download storage.

importLegacyCaptureHint.message: Choose data\captures, a work folder, or a quality folder to resume gaps / create video.

legacyAskProduct.message: You selected a quality folder. Enter a name for this work (used as the file name):

legacyPlaylistEmpty.message: Could not parse a segment list from $LABEL$.

legacySegmentsUnmatched.message: The playlist for $LABEL$ does not match the segment files in that folder.

legacyImportMissing.message: Imported $DONE$ segments; $MISSING$ gap(s) remain. Open the original page and switch to web-assisted saving to use smart fill / playback speed.

legacyImportReady.message: Imported $COUNT$ segments. You can create the video now. For subtitles or faster assisted capture later, open the original page and switch to web-assisted saving.

legacyImportStarting.message: Preparing to import $COUNT$ legacy quality folder(s)…

legacyFolderUnrecognized.message: No legacy capture folder was recognized. Choose data\captures, a work folder, or a quality folder that contains .ts files.

legacyKeyMissing.message: The legacy decryption key is not loaded. Re-import the folder, or reopen the task to restore the key.

directoryPickerUnavailable.message: This browser cannot open a folder picker.
